candidate.title: KRAUS SIEVE MODULAR METHOD EXTENSION FOR SIGNATURE (3, 3, p) ON [5101, 5200]
candidate.claim: No non-trivial primitive solutions exist for signature (3, 3, p) for all prime exponents p in [5101, 5200].
candidate.method: Modular method level lowering to conductor 72, Kraus sieve relations at auxiliary primes q = 2kp + 1 with a_q(f) = 0 mod 2.
obligations: Verify PARI/GP traces and formalize Lean 4 theorems for p up to 5200.
candidate.novelty_note: Advances empirical verification frontier to exponent 5200.
extracted: Kraus sieve eliminates all 7 primes p in [5101, 5200] with p = 1 mod 3; remaining primes eliminated by Darmon-Merel.
